# event type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:eventType`](gmeow-eventType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/eventType>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/events`](../../slices/events.md)

The kind(s) of an event, drawn from the open [`gmeow:EventType`](../classes/gmeow-EventType.md) value vocabulary. Non-functional: an occurrence may carry several types (a wedding that is also a religious rite), and competing standpoint-indexed type claims coexist rather than contradict.
